params.name: Head
params.desc: header line for protocol.

params.name: RUN
params.desc: the RUN number is used as extension for all output files (see Table 3). It is automatically incremented if a LOOP is specified.

params.name: LOOP
params.desc: see chapter 4.9.

params.name: NLoop
params.desc: see chapter 4.9.

params.name: Distribution
params.desc: name of the initial particle distribution, see chapters 2 and 3.

params.name: ion_mass( )
params.desc: the mass divided by the charge state of user defined particles. Negatively charged particles are defined by a negative value of the ion_mass parameter. Particle index 5 – 14 in the input distribution file refer to ion_mass(1) – (10). See also the corresponding generator definitions (7). Mass proportional results (energy and momenta) are normalized to the charge state!

params.name: N_red
params.desc: if >1 only every N_redthparticle of the distribution is used. The charge of the particles is scaled accordingly.

params.name: Xoff
params.desc: horizontal offset of the input distribution. Active if Xoff ≠ 0.0.

params.name: Yoff
params.desc: vertical offset of the input distribution. Active if Yoff ≠ 0.0.

params.name: xp
params.desc: horizontal trajectory angle, additive to input distribution.

params.name: yp
params.desc: vertical trajectory angle, additive to input distribution.

params.name: Zoff
params.desc: longitudinal offset of the input distribution. Active if Zoff ≠ 0.0.

params.name: Toff
params.desc: timing offset of the input distribution. Active if Toff ≠ 0.0.

params.name: Xrms
params.desc: horizontal rms beam size. Scaling is active if Xrms >0.0.

params.name: Yrms
params.desc: vertical rms beam size. Scaling is active if Yrms > 0.0.

params.name: XYrms
params.desc: horizontal and vertical rms beam size. The parameter XYrms has priority over the parameters Xrms and Yrms.

params.name: Zrms
params.desc: rms bunch length. Scaling is active if Zrms > 0.0.

params.name: Trms
params.desc: emission time of the bunch. Scaling is active if Trms > 0.0.

params.name: Tau
params.desc: exponential delay time of the emission. Active if Tau ≠ 0.0. Note that the delay time is random and might interfere with the quasi random nature of an input distribution.

params.name: cor_px
params.desc: correlated divergence of the bunch. Scaling is active if cor_px ≠ 0.0.

params.name: cor_py
params.desc: correlated divergence of the bunch. Scaling is active if cor_py ≠ 0.0.

params.name: Qbunch
params.desc: bunch charge. Scaling is active if Qbunch ≠ 0.0.

params.name: SRT_Q_Schottky
params.desc: variation of the bunch charge with the square root of the field on the cathode. Scaling is active if SRT_Q_Schottky ≠ 0.0.

params.name: Q_Schottky
params.desc: linear variation of the bunch charge with the field on the cathode. Scaling is active if Q_Schottky ≠ 0.0.

params.name: debunch
params.desc: ‘debunched’ particles, i.e. particles with a distance to the bunch center exceeding debunch·σz are passivated, i.e. their status will be set to 0 or 1. Debunch is defined relative to the rms bunch length, hence it should not be used close to the cathode where σz can be zero. The procedure is active when debunch is ≠ 0.0

params.name: Track_All
params.desc: if false, only the reference particle will be tracked. The ref file contains the off-axis results in this case.

params.name: Track_On_Axis
params.desc: if true, the reference particle will be tracked only on axis. The ref file contains the on-axis results in this case.

params.name: Auto_Phase
params.desc: if true, the RF phases will be set relative to the phase with maximum energy gain.
